func parseInfoStyle(str string) (infoStyle, string, error) {
	switch str {
	case "default":
		return infoDefault, "", nil
	case "right":
		return infoRight, "", nil
	case "inline":
		return infoInline, defaultInfoPrefix, nil
	case "inline-right":
		return infoInlineRight, "", nil
	case "hidden":
		return infoHidden, "", nil
	default:
		type infoSpec struct {
			name  string
			style infoStyle
		}
		for _, spec := range []infoSpec{
			{"inline", infoInline},
			{"inline-right", infoInlineRight}} {
			if strings.HasPrefix(str, spec.name+":") {
				return spec.style, strings.ReplaceAll(str[len(spec.name)+1:], "\n", " "), nil
			}
		}
	}
	return infoDefault, "", errors.New("invalid info style (expected: default|right|hidden|inline[-right][:PREFIX])")
}

const defaultInfoPrefix = " < "

func parsePreviewWindow(opts *previewOpts, input string) error {
	return parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts, input)
}

var (
	previewSizeRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]+%?$`)
	previewOffsetRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\+{-?[0-9]+})?([+-][0-9]+)*(-?/[1-9][0-9]*)?$`)
	previewAltRegex    = regexp.MustCompile(`^<([1-9][0-9]*)\(([^)]+)\)$`)
)

func parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts *previewOpts, input string) error {
	tokenRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`[:,]*(<([1-9][0-9]*)\(([^)]+)\)|[^,:]+)`)
	tokens := tokenRegex.FindAllStringSubmatch(input, -1)
	for _, match := range tokens {
		if len(match[2]) > 0 {
			size, err := atoi(match[2])
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.threshold = size
			opts.alternative = &previewOpts{}
			*opts.alternative = *opts
			opts.alternative.threshold = 0
			opts.alternative.alternative = nil
			if err := parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts.alternative, match[3]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		token := match[1]
		switch token {
		case "":
		case "default":
			*opts = defaultPreviewOpts(opts.command)
		case "hidden":
			opts.hidden = true
		case "nohidden":
			opts.hidden = false
		case "wrap":
			opts.wrap = true
		case "nowrap":
			opts.wrap = false
		case "cycle":
			opts.cycle = true
		case "nocycle":
			opts.cycle = false
		case "up", "top":
			opts.position = posUp
		case "down", "bottom":
			opts.position = posDown
		case "left":
			opts.position = posLeft
		case "right":
			opts.position = posRight
		case "rounded", "border", "border-rounded":
			opts.border = BorderRounded
		case "sharp", "border-sharp":
			opts.border = BorderSharp
		case "noborder", "border-none":
			opts.border = BorderNone
		case "border-line":
			opts.border = BorderLine
		case "border-bold":
			opts.border = BorderBold
		case "border-block":
			opts.border = BorderBlock
		case "border-thinblock":
			opts.border = BorderThinBlock
		case "border-double":
			opts.border = BorderDouble
		case "border-horizontal":
			opts.border = BorderHorizontal
		case "border-vertical":
			opts.border = BorderVertical
		case "border-up", "border-top":
			opts.border = BorderTop
		case "border-down", "border-bottom":
			opts.border = BorderBottom
		case "border-left":
			opts.border = BorderLeft
		case "border-right":
			opts.border = BorderRight
		case "follow":
			opts.follow = true
		case "nofollow":
			opts.follow = false
		case "info":
			opts.info = true
		case "noinfo":
			opts.info = false
		default:
			if headerLinesRegex := regexp.MustCompile("^~(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"); headerLinesRegex.MatchString(token) {
				opts.headerLines, _ = atoi(token[1:])
			} else if previewOffsetRegex.MatchString(token) {
				opts.scroll = token
			} else if previewSizeRegex.MatchString(token) {
				size, err := parseSize(token, 99, "window size")
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				opts.size = size
			} else {
				return errors.New("invalid preview window option: " + token)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseSize(str string, maxPercent float64, label string) (sizeSpec, error) {
	var val float64
	percent := strings.HasSuffix(str, "%")
	if percent {
		var err error
		val, err = atof(str[:len(str)-1])
		if err != nil {
			return sizeSpec{}, err
		}
		if val < 0 {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " must be non-negative")
		}
		if val > maxPercent {
			return sizeSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%s too large (max: %d%%)", label, int(maxPercent))
		}
	} else {
		if strings.Contains(str, ".") {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " (without %) must be a non-negative integer")
		}

		var err error
		v, err := atoi(str)
		if err != nil {
			return sizeSpec{}, err
		}
		val = float64(v)
		if val < 0 {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " must be non-negative")
		}
	}
	return sizeSpec{val, percent}, nil
}

func parseMargin(opt string, margin string) ([4]sizeSpec, error) {
	margins := strings.Split(margin, ",")
	checked := func(str string) (sizeSpec, error) {
		return parseSize(str, 49, opt)
	}
	switch len(margins) {
	case 1:
		m, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{m, m, m, m}, nil
	case 2:
		tb, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		rl, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{tb, rl, tb, rl}, nil
	case 3:
		t, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		rl, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		b, err := checked(margins[2])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{t, rl, b, rl}, nil
	case 4:
		t, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		r, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		b, err := checked(margins[2])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		l, err := checked(margins[3])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{t, r, b, l}, nil
	}
	return defaultMargin(), errors.New("invalid " + opt + ": " + margin)
}

func parseLabelPosition(opts *labelOpts, arg string) error {
	opts.column = 0
	opts.bottom = false
	for _, token := range splitRegexp.Split(strings.ToLower(arg), -1) {
		switch token {
		case "center":
			opts.column = 0
		case "bottom":
			opts.bottom = true
		case "top":
			opts.bottom = false
		default:
			var err error
			opts.column, err = atoi(token)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseWalkerOpts(str string) (walkerOpts, error) {
	opts := walkerOpts{}
	for _, str := range strings.Split(strings.ToLower(str), ",") {
		switch str {
		case "file":
			opts.file = true
		case "dir":
			opts.dir = true
		case "hidden":
			opts.hidden = true
		case "follow":
			opts.follow = true
		case "":
			// Ignored
		default:
			return opts, errors.New("invalid walker option: " + str)
		}
	}
	if !opts.file && !opts.dir {
		return opts, errors.New("at least one of 'file' or 'dir' should be specified")
	}
	return opts, nil
}

func parseTmuxOptions(arg string) (*tmuxOptions, error) {
	var err error
	opts := tmuxOptions{}
	tokens := strings.Split(arg, ",")
	errorToReturn := errors.New("invalid tmux option: " + arg + " (expected: [center|top|bottom|left|right][,SIZE[%]][,SIZE[%][,border-native]])")
	if len(tokens) == 0 || len(tokens) > 4 {
		return nil, errorToReturn
	}

	// Defaults
	opts.position = tmuxCenter
	opts.width = sizeSpec{50, true}
	opts.height = sizeSpec{50, true}

	switch tokens[0] {
	case "top", "up":
		opts.position = tmuxTop
		opts.width = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "bottom", "down":
		opts.position = tmuxBottom
		opts.width = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "left":
		opts.position = tmuxLeft
		opts.height = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "right":
		opts.position = tmuxRight
		opts.height = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "center":
	default:
		tokens = append([]string{"center"}, tokens...)
	}

	// Remove "border-native" if present
	hasBorder := false
	filtered := []string{}
	for _, token := range tokens {
		if token == "border-native" {
			hasBorder = true
		} else {
			filtered = append(filtered, token)
		}
	}
	tokens = filtered
	opts.border = hasBorder

	if len(tokens) > 3 {
		return nil, errorToReturn
	}

	// One size given
	var size1 sizeSpec
	if len(tokens) > 1 {
		if size1, err = parseSize(tokens[1], 100, "size"); err != nil {
			return nil, errorToReturn
		}
	}
	var size2 sizeSpec
	if len(tokens) > 2 {
		if size2, err = parseSize(tokens[2], 100, "size"); err != nil {
			return nil, errorToReturn
		}
	}

	switch len(tokens) {
	case 2:
		switch opts.position {
		case tmuxCenter:
			opts.width = size1
			opts.height = size1
		case tmuxTop, tmuxBottom:
			opts.height = size1
		case tmuxLeft, tmuxRight:
			opts.width = size1
		}
	case 3:
		opts.width = size1
		opts.height = size2
	}

	return &opts, nil
}

func validateSign(sign *string, signOptName string) error {
	if sign == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if StringWidth(*sign) > 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%v display width should be up to 2", signOptName)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateGutter(sign *string, signOptName string) error {
	if sign == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if StringWidth(*sign) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%v display width should be 1", signOptName)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateJumpLabels(labels string) error {
	for _, r := range labels {
		if r < 32 || r > 126 {
			return errors.New("non-ascii jump labels are not allowed")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func processScheme(opts *Options) error {
	if !initScheme(strings.ToLower(opts.Scheme)) {
		return errors.New("invalid scoring scheme: " + opts.Scheme + " (expected: default|path|history)")
	}
	if opts.Scheme == "history" {
		opts.Criteria = []criterion{byScore}
	}
	if opts.Scheme == "path" {
		opts.Criteria = []criterion{byScore, byPathname, byLength}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseListenAddress(address string) (*listenAddress, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(address, ".sock") {
		return &listenAddress{path: address}, nil
	}
	parts := strings.SplitN(address, ":", 2)
	if len(parts) == 1 {
		parts = []string{"localhost", parts[0]}
	}
	if len(parts[0]) == 0 {
		parts[0] = "localhost"
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
	if err != nil || port < 0 || port > 65535 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid listen port: %s", parts[1])
	}
	if len(parts[0]) == 0 {
		parts[0] = "localhost"
	}
	return &listenAddress{parts[0], port, ""}, nil
}

func strLines(str string) []string {
	return strings.Split(strings.TrimSuffix(str, "\n"), "\n")
}

func parseOptions(opts *Options, allArgs []string) error {
	var err error
	var historyMax int
	if opts.History == nil {
		historyMax = defaultHistoryMax
	} else {
		historyMax = opts.History.maxSize
	}
	setHistory := func(path string) error {
		h, e := NewHistory(path, historyMax)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		opts.History = h
		return nil
	}
	setHistoryMax := func(max int) error {
		historyMax = max
		if historyMax < 1 {
			return errors.New("history max must be a positive integer")
		}
		if opts.History != nil {
			opts.History.maxSize = historyMax
		}
		return nil
	}
	validateJumpLabelsFn := func() error {
		if opts.JumpLabels == "" {
			return errors.New("empty jump labels")
		}
		return validateJumpLabels(opts.JumpLabels)
	}

	clearExitingOpts := func() {
		// Last-one-wins strategy
		opts.Bash = false
		opts.Zsh = false
		opts.Fish = false
		opts.Help = false
		opts.Version = false
		opts.Man = false
	}

	for i := 0; i < len(allArgs); i++ {
		arg := allArgs[i]
		switch arg {
		case "--bash":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Bash = true
		case "--zsh":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Zsh = true
		case "--fish":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Fish = true
		case "--man":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Man = true
		case "-h", "--help":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Help = true
		case "--version":
			clearExitingOpts()
			opts.Version = true
		case "--no-winpty":
			opts.NoWinpty = true
		case "--tmux":
			given, str := optionalNextString(allArgs, &i)
			if given {
				if opts.Tmux, err = parseTmuxOptions(str); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			} else {
				opts.Tmux, _ = parseTmuxOptions("center")
			}
		case "--no-tmux":
			opts.Tmux = nil
		case "--force-tty-in":
			opts.ForceTtyIn = true
		case "--no-force-tty-in":
			opts.ForceTtyIn = false
		case "--proxy-script":
			if opts.ProxyScript, err = nextString(allArgs, &i, ""); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "-x", "--extended":
			opts.Extended = true
		case "-e", "--exact":
			opts.Fuzzy = false
		case "--extended-exact":
			// Note that we now don't have --no-extended-exact
			opts.Fuzzy = false
			opts.Extended = true
		case "+x", "--no-extended":
			opts.Extended = false
		case "+e", "--no-exact":
			opts.Fuzzy = true
		case "-q", "--query":
			if opts.Query, err = nextString(allArgs, &i, "query string required"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "-f", "--filter":
			filter, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "query string required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.Filter = &filter
		case "--literal":
			opts.Normalize = false
		case "--no-literal":
			opts.Normalize = true
		case "--algo":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "algorithm required (v1|v2)")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if opts.FuzzyAlgo, err = parseAlgo(str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "--scheme":
			if opts.Scheme, err = nextString(allArgs, &i, "scoring scheme required (default|path|history)"); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.Scheme = strings.ToLower(opts.Scheme)
		case "--expect":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "key names required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			chords, err := parseKeyChords(str, "key names required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			for k, v := range chords {
				opts.Expect[k] = v
			}
		case "--no-expect":
			opts.Expect = make(map[Event]string)
		case "--enabled", "--no-phony":
			opts.Phony = false
		case "--disabled", "--phony":
			opts.Phony = true
		case "--tiebreak":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "sort criterion required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if opts.Criteria, err = parseTiebreak(str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "--bind":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "bind expression required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := parseKeymap(opts.Keymap, str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "--color":
			_, spec := optionalNextString(allArgs, &i)
			if len(spec) == 0 {
				opts.Theme = EmptyTheme()
			} else {
				if opts.Theme, err = parseTheme(opts.Theme, spec); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		case "--toggle-sort":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "key name required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := parseToggleSort(opts.Keymap, str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "-d", "--delimiter":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "delimiter required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.Delimiter = delimiterRegexp(str)
		case "-n", "--nth":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "nth expression required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if opts.Nth, err = splitNth(str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "--with-nth":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "nth expression required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if opts.WithNth, err = parseNthTemplate(str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.WithNthRaw = str
		case "--accept-nth":
			str, err := nextString(allArgs, &i, "nth expression required")
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if opts.AcceptNth, err = parseNthTemplate(str); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		case "-s", "--sort":
			opts.Sort = optionalNumericNoErr(allArgs, &i, 1)
		case "+s", "--no-sort":
			opts.Sort = 0
		case "--track":
			opts.Track = trackEnabled
		case "--no-track":
			opts.Track = trackDisabled
		case "--tac":
			opts.Tac = true
		case "--no-tac":

func parseMinHeight(str string) (int, bool, error) {
	add := false
	if strings.HasSuffix(str, "+") {
		add = true
		str = str[:len(str)-1]
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(str)
	if err != nil || n < 0 {
		return 0, false, errors.New("minimum height must be a non-negative integer")
	}
	return n, add, nil
}

func parseMarkerMultiLine(str string) (*[3]string, error) {
	gr := Graphemes(str)
	totalWidth := StringWidth(str)
	if totalWidth != 0 && totalWidth != 3 && totalWidth != 6 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid total marker width: %d (expected: 0, 3 or 6)", totalWidth)
	}

	expected := totalWidth / 3
	result := [3]string{}
	idx := 0
	for _, g := range gr {
		if idx >= 3 {
			break
		}
		w := StringWidth(g)
		if w == expected {
			result[idx] = g
			idx++
		} else if w > expected {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid marker width: %d (expected: %d)", w, expected)
		} else {
			// Accumulate smaller graphemes
			result[idx] += g
			if StringWidth(result[idx]) >= expected {
				idx++
			}
		}
	}
	return &result, nil
}

func firstLine(s string) string {
	if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
		return s[:i]

	}
	keymap[firstKey(keys)] = toActions(actToggleSort)
	return nil

func applyPreset(opts *Options, preset string) error {
	parts := strings.SplitN(preset, ":", 2)
	borderStyle := BorderRounded
	if len(parts) == 2 {
		if parts[0] != "full" {
			return errors.New("unsupported style preset: " + preset)
		}
		var err error
		if borderStyle, err = parseBorder(parts[1], true); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	switch parts[0] {
	case "default":
		opts.Style = "default"
	case "minimal":
		opts.Style = "minimal"
		opts.Separator = nil
		noSep := ""
		opts.Separator = &noSep
		noBar := ""
		opts.Scrollbar = &noBar
		opts.InfoStyle = infoInline
		opts.InfoPrefix = defaultInfoPrefix
		ptr := ">"
		opts.Pointer = &ptr
		marker := ">"
		opts.Marker = &marker
		opts.CursorLine = false
	case "full":
		opts.Style = "full"
		opts.CursorLine = true
		opts.ListBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.InputBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderLinesShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderLinesBorderSet = true
		opts.FooterBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.Preview.border = borderStyle
		opts.InfoStyle = infoDefault
	default:
		return errors.New("unsupported style preset: " + preset)
	}
	return nil
}

func splitNth(str string) ([]Range, error) {
	if match, _ := regexp.MatchString("^[0-9,-.]+$", str); !match {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid format: " + str)
	}

	tokens := strings.Split(str, ",")
	ranges := make([]Range, len(tokens))
	for idx, s := range tokens {
		r, ok := ParseRange(&s)
		if !ok {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid format: " + str)
		}
		ranges[idx] = r
	}
	return ranges, nil
}

func delimiterRegexp(str string) Delimiter {
	// Special handling of \t
	str = strings.ReplaceAll(str, "\\t", "\t")

	// 1. Pattern does not contain any special character
	if regexp.QuoteMeta(str) == str {
		return Delimiter{str: &str}
	}

	rx, e := regexp.Compile(str)
	// 2. Pattern is not a valid regular expression
	if e != nil {
		return Delimiter{str: &str}
	}

	// 3. Pattern as regular expression. Slow.
	return Delimiter{regex: rx}
}

func parseTiebreak(str string) ([]criterion, error) {
	criteria := []criterion{byScore}
	hasIndex := false
	hasChunk := false
	hasLength := false
	hasBegin := false
	hasEnd := false
	hasPathname := false
	check := func(notExpected *bool, name string) error {
		if *notExpected {
			return errors.New("duplicate sort criteria: " + name)
		}
		if hasIndex {
			return errors.New("index should be the last criterion")
		}
		*notExpected = true
		return nil
	}
	for _, str := range strings.Split(strings.ToLower(str), ",") {
		switch str {
		case "index":
			if err := check(&hasIndex, "index"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case "chunk":
			if err := check(&hasChunk, "chunk"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			criteria = append(criteria, byChunk)
		case "length":
			if err := check(&hasLength, "length"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			criteria = append(criteria, byLength)
		case "pathname":
			if err := check(&hasPathname, "pathname"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			criteria = append(criteria, byPathname)
		case "begin":
			if err := check(&hasBegin, "begin"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			criteria = append(criteria, byBegin)
		case "end":
			if err := check(&hasEnd, "end"); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			criteria = append(criteria, byEnd)
		default:
			return nil, errors.New("invalid sort criterion: " + str)
		}
	}
	if len(criteria) > 4 {
		return nil, errors.New("at most 3 tiebreaks are allowed: " + str)
	}
	return criteria, nil
}

func parseTheme(defaultTheme *ColorTheme, str string) (*ColorTheme, error) {
	theme := copyTheme(defaultTheme)
	rrggbb := regexp.MustCompile("^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$")
	for _, str := range strings.Split(strings.ToLower(str), ",") {
		switch str {
		case "":
		case "dark":
			theme = copyTheme(Dark256)
		case "light":
			theme = copyTheme(Light256)
		case "16":
			theme = copyTheme(Default16)
		case "bw", "no":
			theme = NoColorTheme()
		default:
			fail := func() (*ColorTheme, error) {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid color specification: " + str)
			}
			// Color is disabled
			if theme == nil || !theme.Colored {
				continue
			}

			components := strings.Split(str, ":")
			if len(components) < 2 {
				return fail()
			}

			mergeAttr := func(cattr *ColorAttr) error {
				for _, component := range components[1:] {
					switch component {
					case "regular":
						cattr.Attr = AttrRegular
					case "bold", "strong":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrBold
					case "dim":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrDim
					case "italic":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrItalic
					case "underline":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrUnderline
					case "blink":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrBlink
					case "reverse":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrReverse
					case "strikethrough":
						cattr.Attr |= AttrStrikeThrough
					case "black":
						cattr.Color = colBlack
					case "red":
						cattr.Color = colRed
					case "green":
						cattr.Color = colGreen
					case "yellow":
						cattr.Color = colYellow
					case "blue":
						cattr.Color = colBlue
					case "magenta":
						cattr.Color = colMagenta
					case "cyan":
						cattr.Color = colCyan
					case "white":
						cattr.Color = colWhite
					case "bright-black", "gray", "grey":
						cattr.Color = colBlack + 8
					case "bright-red":
						cattr.Color = colRed + 8
					case "bright-green":
						cattr.Color = colGreen + 8
					case "bright-yellow":
						cattr.Color = colYellow + 8
					case "bright-blue":
						cattr.Color = colBlue + 8
					case "bright-magenta":
						cattr.Color = colMagenta + 8
					case "bright-cyan":
						cattr.Color = colCyan + 8
					case "bright-white":
						cattr.Color = colWhite + 8
					case "":
					default:
						if rrggbb.MatchString(component) {
							cattr.Color = HexToColor(component)
						} else {
							ansi32, err := strconv.Atoi(component)
							if err != nil || ansi32 < -1 || ansi32 > 255 {
								return errors.New("invalid color specification: " + str)
							}
							cattr.Color = Color(ansi32)
						}
					}
				}
				return nil
			}
			var err error
			switch components[0] {
			case "query", "input", "input-fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Input)
			case "disabled":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Disabled)
			case "fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Fg)
			case "bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Bg)
			case "list-fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.ListFg)
			case "list-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.ListBg)
			case "preview-fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.PreviewFg)
			case "preview-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.PreviewBg)
			case "fg+", "current-fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Current)
			case "bg+", "current-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.DarkBg)
			case "gutter":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Gutter)
			case "hl":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Match)
			case "hl+", "current-hl":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.CurrentMatch)
			case "selected-fg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.SelectedFg)
			case "selected-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.SelectedBg)
			case "selected-hl":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.SelectedMatch)
			case "border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Border)
			case "preview-border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.PreviewBorder)
			case "preview-scrollbar":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.PreviewScrollbar)
			case "preview-label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.PreviewLabel)
			case "label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.BorderLabel)
			case "list-label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.ListLabel)
			case "list-border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.ListBorder)
			case "input-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.InputBg)
			case "input-border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.InputBorder)
			case "input-label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.InputLabel)
			case "header-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.HeaderBg)
			case "header-border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.HeaderBorder)
			case "header-label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.HeaderLabel)
			case "footer-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.FooterBg)
			case "footer-border":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.FooterBorder)
			case "footer-label":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.FooterLabel)
			case "prompt":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Prompt)
			case "spinner":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Spinner)
			case "info":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Info)
			case "pointer":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Cursor)
			case "marker":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Marker)
			case "header":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Header)
			case "footer":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Footer)
			case "scrollbar":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Scrollbar)
			case "separator":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Separator)
			case "gap-line":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.GapLine)
			case "ghost":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Ghost)
			case "alt-bg":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.AltBg)
			case "alt-gutter":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.AltGutter)
			case "nth":
				err = mergeAttr(&theme.Nth)
				if err == nil && theme.Nth.Color != colUndefined {
					return nil, errors.New("only ANSI attributes are allowed for 'nth' (regular, bold, underline, reverse, dim, italic, strikethrough)")
				}
			default:
				return fail()
			}
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}
	return theme, nil
}

func HexToColor(rrggbb string) Color {
	r, _ := strconv.ParseInt(rrggbb[1:3], 16, 0)
	g, _ := strconv.ParseInt(rrggbb[3:5], 16, 0)
	b, _ := strconv.ParseInt(rrggbb[5:7], 16, 0)
	return Color((1 << 24) + (r << 16) + (g << 8) + b)
}

	case "inline-right":

			}
		}
	}
	return infoDefault, "", errors.New("invalid info style (expected: default|right|hidden|inline[-right][:PREFIX])")
}

func parsePreviewWindow(opts *previewOpts, input string) error {
	return parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts, input)
}

var (
	previewSizeRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]+%?$`)
	previewOffsetRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\+{-?[0-9]+})?([+-][0-9]+)*(-?/[1-9][0-9]*)?$`)
	previewAltRegex    = regexp.MustCompile(`^<([1-9][0-9]*)\(([^)]+)\)$`)
)

func parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts *previewOpts, input string) error {
	tokenRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`[:,]*(<([1-9][0-9]*)\(([^)]+)\)|[^,:]+)`)
	tokens := tokenRegex.FindAllStringSubmatch(input, -1)
	for _, match := range tokens {
		if len(match[2]) > 0 {
			size, err := atoi(match[2])
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			opts.threshold = size
			opts.alternative = &previewOpts{}
			*opts.alternative = *opts
			opts.alternative.threshold = 0
			opts.alternative.alternative = nil
			if err := parsePreviewWindowImpl(opts.alternative, match[3]); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}
		token := match[1]
		switch token {
		case "":
		case "default":
			*opts = defaultPreviewOpts(opts.command)
		case "hidden":
			opts.hidden = true
		case "nohidden":
			opts.hidden = false
		case "wrap":
			opts.wrap = true
		case "nowrap":
			opts.wrap = false
		case "cycle":
			opts.cycle = true
		case "nocycle":
			opts.cycle = false
		case "up", "top":
			opts.position = posUp
		case "down", "bottom":
			opts.position = posDown
		case "left":
			opts.position = posLeft
		case "right":
			opts.position = posRight
		case "rounded", "border", "border-rounded":
			opts.border = BorderRounded
		case "sharp", "border-sharp":
			opts.border = BorderSharp
		case "noborder", "border-none":
			opts.border = BorderNone
		case "border-line":
			opts.border = BorderLine
		case "border-bold":
			opts.border = BorderBold
		case "border-block":
			opts.border = BorderBlock
		case "border-thinblock":
			opts.border = BorderThinBlock
		case "border-double":
			opts.border = BorderDouble
		case "border-horizontal":
			opts.border = BorderHorizontal
		case "border-vertical":
			opts.border = BorderVertical
		case "border-up", "border-top":
			opts.border = BorderTop
		case "border-down", "border-bottom":
			opts.border = BorderBottom
		case "border-left":
			opts.border = BorderLeft
		case "border-right":
			opts.border = BorderRight
		case "follow":
			opts.follow = true
		case "nofollow":
			opts.follow = false
		case "info":
			opts.info = true
		case "noinfo":
			opts.info = false
		default:
			if headerLinesRegex := regexp.MustCompile("^~(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$"); headerLinesRegex.MatchString(token) {
				opts.headerLines, _ = atoi(token[1:])
			} else if previewOffsetRegex.MatchString(token) {
				opts.scroll = token
			} else if previewSizeRegex.MatchString(token) {
				size, err := parseSize(token, 99, "window size")
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				opts.size = size
			} else {
				return errors.New("invalid preview window option: " + token)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func parseSize(str string, maxPercent float64, label string) (sizeSpec, error) {
	var val float64
	percent := strings.HasSuffix(str, "%")
	if percent {
		var err error
		val, err = atof(str[:len(str)-1])
		if err != nil {
			return sizeSpec{}, err
		}
		if val < 0 {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " must be non-negative")
		}
		if val > maxPercent {
			return sizeSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("%s too large (max: %d%%)", label, int(maxPercent))
		}
	} else {
		if strings.Contains(str, ".") {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " (without %) must be a non-negative integer")
		}

		var err error
		v, err := atoi(str)
		if err != nil {
			return sizeSpec{}, err
		}
		val = float64(v)
		if val < 0 {
			return sizeSpec{}, errors.New(label + " must be non-negative")
		}
	}
	return sizeSpec{val, percent}, nil
}

func parseMargin(opt string, margin string) ([4]sizeSpec, error) {
	margins := strings.Split(margin, ",")
	checked := func(str string) (sizeSpec, error) {
		return parseSize(str, 49, opt)
	}
	switch len(margins) {
	case 1:
		m, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{m, m, m, m}, nil
	case 2:
		tb, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		rl, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{tb, rl, tb, rl}, nil
	case 3:
		t, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		rl, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		b, err := checked(margins[2])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{t, rl, b, rl}, nil
	case 4:
		t, err := checked(margins[0])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		r, err := checked(margins[1])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		b, err := checked(margins[2])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		l, err := checked(margins[3])
		if err != nil {
			return defaultMargin(), err
		}
		return [4]sizeSpec{t, r, b, l}, nil
	}
	return defaultMargin(), errors.New("invalid " + opt + ": " + margin)
}

func parseTmuxOptions(arg string) (*tmuxOptions, error) {
	var err error
	opts := tmuxOptions{}
	tokens := strings.Split(arg, ",")
	errorToReturn := errors.New("invalid tmux option: " + arg + " (expected: [center|top|bottom|left|right][,SIZE[%]][,SIZE[%][,border-native]])")
	if len(tokens) == 0 || len(tokens) > 4 {
		return nil, errorToReturn
	}

	// Defaults
	opts.position = tmuxCenter
	opts.width = sizeSpec{50, true}
	opts.height = sizeSpec{50, true}

	switch tokens[0] {
	case "top", "up":
		opts.position = tmuxTop
		opts.width = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "bottom", "down":
		opts.position = tmuxBottom
		opts.width = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "left":
		opts.position = tmuxLeft
		opts.height = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "right":
		opts.position = tmuxRight
		opts.height = sizeSpec{100, true}
	case "center":
	default:
		tokens = append([]string{"center"}, tokens...)
	}

	// Remove "border-native" if present
	hasBorder := false
	filtered := []string{}
	for _, token := range tokens {
		if token == "border-native" {
			hasBorder = true
		} else {
			filtered = append(filtered, token)
		}
	}
	tokens = filtered
	opts.border = hasBorder

	if len(tokens) > 3 {
		return nil, errorToReturn
	}

	// One size given
	var size1 sizeSpec
	if len(tokens) > 1 {
		if size1, err = parseSize(tokens[1], 100, "size"); err != nil {
			return nil, errorToReturn
		}
	}
	var size2 sizeSpec
	if len(tokens) > 2 {
		if size2, err = parseSize(tokens[2], 100, "size"); err != nil {
			return nil, errorToReturn
		}
	}

	switch len(tokens) {
	case 2:
		switch opts.position {
		case tmuxCenter:
			opts.width = size1
			opts.height = size1
		case tmuxTop, tmuxBottom:
			opts.height = size1
		case tmuxLeft, tmuxRight:
			opts.width = size1
		}
	case 3:
		opts.width = size1
		opts.height = size2
	}

	return &opts, nil
}

	if opts.Scheme == "history" {

func parseListenAddress(address string) (*listenAddress, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(address, ".sock") {
		return &listenAddress{path: address}, nil
	}
	parts := strings.SplitN(address, ":", 2)
	if len(parts) == 1 {
		parts = []string{"localhost", parts[0]}
	}
	if len(parts[0]) == 0 {
		parts[0] = "localhost"
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
	if err != nil || port < 0 || port > 65535 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid listen port: %s", parts[1])
	}
	if len(parts[0]) == 0 {
		parts[0] = "localhost"
	}
	return &listenAddress{parts[0], port, ""}, nil
}

func parseOptions(opts *Options, allArgs []string) error {
	var err error
	var historyMax int
	if opts.History == nil {
		historyMax = defaultHistoryMax
	} else {
		historyMax = opts.History.maxSize
	}
	setHistory := func(path string) error {
		h, e := NewHistory(path, historyMax)
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		opts.History = h
		return nil
	}
	setHistoryMax := func(max int) error {
		historyMax = max
		if historyMax < 1 {
			return errors.New("history max must be a positive integer")
		}
		if opts.History != nil {

func optionalNumericNoErr(args []string, i *int, defaultValue int) int {
	v, _ := optionalNumeric(args, i, defaultValue)
	return v
}

func parseMinHeight(str string) (int, bool, error) {
	add := false
	if strings.HasSuffix(str, "+") {
		add = true
		str = str[:len(str)-1]
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(str)
	if err != nil || n < 0 {
		return 0, false, errors.New("minimum height must be a non-negative integer")
	}
	return n, add, nil
}

func parseMarkerMultiLine(str string) (*[3]string, error) {
	gr := Graphemes(str)
	totalWidth := StringWidth(str)
	if totalWidth != 0 && totalWidth != 3 && totalWidth != 6 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid total marker width: %d (expected: 0, 3 or 6)", totalWidth)
	}

	expected := totalWidth / 3
	result := [3]string{}
	idx := 0
	for _, g := range gr {
		if idx >= 3 {
			break
		}
		w := StringWidth(g)
		if w == expected {
			result[idx] = g
			idx++
		} else if w > expected {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid marker width: %d (expected: %d)", w, expected)
		} else {
			// Accumulate smaller graphemes
			result[idx] += g
			if StringWidth(result[idx]) >= expected {
				idx++
			}
		}
	}
	return &result, nil
}

func firstLine(s string) string {
	if i := strings.IndexByte(s, '\n'); i >= 0 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return s
}

func parseToggleSort(keymap map[Event][]*action, str string) error {
	keys, err := parseKeyChords(str, "key name required")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(keys) != 1 {
		return errors.New("multiple keys specified")
	}
	keymap[firstKey(keys)] = toActions(actToggleSort)
	return nil
}

func applyPreset(opts *Options, preset string) error {
	parts := strings.SplitN(preset, ":", 2)
	borderStyle := BorderRounded
	if len(parts) == 2 {
		if parts[0] != "full" {
			return errors.New("unsupported style preset: " + preset)
		}
		var err error
		if borderStyle, err = parseBorder(parts[1], true); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	switch parts[0] {
	case "default":
		opts.Style = "default"
	case "minimal":
		opts.Style = "minimal"
		opts.Separator = nil
		noSep := ""
		opts.Separator = &noSep
		noBar := ""
		opts.Scrollbar = &noBar
		opts.InfoStyle = infoInline
		opts.InfoPrefix = defaultInfoPrefix
		ptr := ">"
		opts.Pointer = &ptr
		marker := ">"
		opts.Marker = &marker
		opts.CursorLine = false
	case "full":
		opts.Style = "full"
		opts.CursorLine = true
		opts.ListBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.InputBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderLinesShape = borderStyle
		opts.HeaderLinesBorderSet = true
		opts.FooterBorderShape = borderStyle
		opts.Preview.border = borderStyle
		opts.InfoStyle = infoDefault
	default:
		return errors.New("unsupported style preset: " + preset)
	}
	return nil
}

func (c *Condition) CreateLUT() {
	const max = 0x110000
	lut := c.combinedLut
	if len(c.combinedLut) != 0 {
		// Remove so we don't use it.
		c.combinedLut = nil
	} else {
		lut = make([]byte, max/2)
	}
	for i := range lut {
		i32 := int32(i * 2)
		x0 := c.RuneWidth(i32)
		x1 := c.RuneWidth(i32 + 1)
		lut[i] = uint8(x0) | uint8(x1)<<4
	}
	c.combinedLut = lut
}

func (c *Condition) StringWidth(s string) (width int) {
	if len(s) == 1 {
		b := s[0]
		if b < 0x20 || b == 0x7F {
			return 0
		}
		return 1
	}
	if len(s) > 0 && len(s) <= utf8.UTFMax {
		r, size := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(s)

	}

// last and next code point. Returns negative values if no transition is found.
//
// This function is used as follows:
//
//  1. Find specific state + specific property. Stop if found.
//  2. Find specific state + any property.
//  3. Find any state + specific property.
//  4. If only (2) or (3) (but not both) was found, stop.
//  5. If both (2) and (3) were found, use state from (3) and breaking instruction
//     from the transition with the lower rule number, prefer (3) if rule numbers

	case grL | prLVT<<32:

	case grAny | prLV<<32:
		return grLVV, grBoundary, 9990
	case grAny | prV<<32:

import subprocess, sys
def order(lines, query):
    data = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    p = subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable", "-f", query, "--tiebreak=index"], input=data.encode(), capture_output=True)
    return p.stdout.decode().split("\n")[:-1]
def cmp(l1, l2, query):
    # returns 1 if l1 > l2, -1 if l1 < l2, 0 if tie
    o1 = order([l1, l2], query)
    o2 = order([l2, l1], query)
    if o1[0] == l1 and o2[0] == l1: return 1
    if o1[0] == l2 and o2[0] == l2: return -1
    return 0
def ruler(j):
    return "a" + "x"*j + "b"   # score 50 - j (j>=1)
def measure(target, ref, refscore, query):
    # find k such that target + ruler(1) == ref + ruler(k)  => S(target) + 49 = refscore + 50 - k => S(target) = refscore + 1 - k
    for k in range(1, 60):
        c = cmp(target + " " + ruler(1), ref + " " + ruler(k), query)
        if c == 0:
            return refscore + 1 - k
        if c > 0:
            return ("between", refscore + 1 - k, refscore + 2 - k)
    return None
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("x_fo:", measure("x_fo", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("x.fo:", measure("x.fo", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("x fo:", measure("x fo", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("fo_a:", measure("fo_a", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))

    print("_fo:", measure("_fo", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("fo_:", measure("fo_", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("x_fo.a:", measure("x_fo.a", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
    print("x_fo-a:", measure("x_fo-a", "x.fo", 56, "'fo' ab"))
EOF

// InitTheme fills in undefined colors with the ones from the base theme
func InitTheme(theme *ColorTheme, baseTheme *ColorTheme, forceBlack bool, bold bool) {
	if !theme.Colored {
		// Use the bw theme: everything default
		base := NoColorTheme()
		*theme = *base
	}
	if forceBlack {
		theme.Bg = ColorAttr{colBlack, AttrUndefined}
	}

	o := func(a ColorAttr, b ColorAttr) ColorAttr {
		if b.Color == colUndefined {
			b.Color = a.Color
		}
		if b.Attr == AttrUndefined {
			b.Attr = a.Attr
		}
		return b
	}
	undefined := NewColorAttr()
	theme.Input = o(baseTheme.Input, theme.Input)
	theme.Fg = o(baseTheme.Fg, theme.Fg)
	theme.Bg = o(baseTheme.Bg, theme.Bg)
	theme.DarkBg = o(baseTheme.DarkBg, theme.DarkBg)
	theme.Prompt = o(baseTheme.Prompt, theme.Prompt)
	theme.Match = o(baseTheme.Match, theme.Match)
	theme.Current = o(baseTheme.Current, theme.Current)
	theme.CurrentMatch = o(baseTheme.CurrentMatch, theme.CurrentMatch)
	theme.Spinner = o(baseTheme.Spinner, theme.Spinner)
	theme.Info = o(baseTheme.Info, theme.Info)
	theme.Cursor = o(baseTheme.Cursor, theme.Cursor)
	theme.Marker = o(baseTheme.Marker, theme.Marker)
	theme.Header = o(baseTheme.Header, theme.Header)
	theme.Border = o(baseTheme.Border, theme.Border)
	theme.BorderLabel = o(baseTheme.BorderLabel, theme.BorderLabel)

	// These colors are not defined in the base theme
	theme.ListFg = o(theme.Fg, theme.ListFg)
	theme.ListBg = o(theme.Bg, theme.ListBg)
	theme.SelectedFg = o(theme.ListFg, theme.SelectedFg)
	theme.SelectedBg = o(theme.ListBg, theme.SelectedBg)
	theme.SelectedMatch = o(theme.Match, theme.SelectedMatch)
	theme.Disabled = o(theme.Input, theme.Disabled)
	theme.Gutter = o(theme.DarkBg, theme.Gutter)
	theme.PreviewFg = o(theme.Fg, theme.PreviewFg)
	theme.PreviewBg = o(theme.Bg, theme.PreviewBg)
	theme.PreviewLabel = o(theme.BorderLabel, theme.PreviewLabel)
	theme.PreviewBorder = o(theme.Border, theme.PreviewBorder)
	theme.Separator = o(theme.Border, theme.Separator)
	theme.Scrollbar = o(theme.Border, theme.Scrollbar)
	theme.PreviewScrollbar = o(theme.PreviewBorder, theme.PreviewScrollbar)
	theme.GapLine = o(theme.Separator, theme.GapLine)
	theme.ListBorder = o(theme.Border, theme.ListBorder)
	theme.ListLabel = o(theme.BorderLabel, theme.ListLabel)
	theme.InputBg = o(theme.Bg, theme.InputBg)
	theme.InputBorder = o(theme.Border, theme.InputBorder)
	theme.InputLabel = o(theme.BorderLabel, theme.InputLabel)
	theme.HeaderBg = o(theme.Bg, theme.HeaderBg)
	theme.HeaderBorder = o(theme.Border, theme.HeaderBorder)
	theme.HeaderLabel = o(theme.BorderLabel, theme.HeaderLabel)
	theme.Footer = o(theme.Header, theme.Footer)
	theme.FooterBg = o(theme.Bg, theme.FooterBg)
	theme.FooterBorder = o(theme.Border, theme.FooterBorder)
	theme.FooterLabel = o(theme.BorderLabel, theme.FooterLabel)
	ghost := theme.Input
	ghost.Attr = AttrDim
	theme.Ghost = o(ghost, theme.Ghost)
	theme.Nth = o(undefined, theme.Nth)
	theme.AltBg = o(undefined, theme.AltBg)
	theme.AltGutter = o(theme.Gutter, theme.AltGutter)

	initPalette(theme, bold)
}

func attrFor(theme *ColorTheme, a ColorAttr, bold bool) Attr {
	attr := a.Attr
	if attr == AttrUndefined {
		attr = 0
	}
	if attr&AttrRegular > 0 {
		attr &^= AttrRegular
	}
	return attr
}

func initPalette(theme *ColorTheme, bold bool) {
	pair := func(fg, bg ColorAttr) ColorPair {
		attr := attrFor(theme, fg, bold)
		attr |= attrFor(theme, bg, bold) & 0 // bg attributes are ignored
		return NewColorPair(fg.Color, bg.Color, attr)
	}
	blank := theme.Fg
	blank.Attr = AttrRegular
	// Emphasized colors are bold by default
	boldIf := func(ca ColorAttr) ColorAttr {
		if bold && ca.Attr == AttrUndefined {
			ca.Attr = AttrBold
		}
		return ca
	}

	ColPrompt = pair(theme.Prompt, theme.InputBg)
	ColNormal = pair(theme.ListFg, theme.ListBg)
	ColList = pair(theme.ListFg, theme.ListBg)
	ColInput = pair(theme.Input, theme.InputBg)
	ColInputBg = pair(theme.Input, theme.InputBg)
	ColDisabled = pair(theme.Disabled, theme.InputBg)
	ColGhost = pair(theme.Ghost, theme.InputBg)
	ColMatch = pair(theme.Match, theme.ListBg)
	ColCursor = pair(boldIf(theme.Cursor), theme.Gutter)
	ColCursorEmpty = pair(blank, theme.Gutter)
	ColMarker = pair(boldIf(theme.Marker), theme.Gutter)
	ColSelected = pair(theme.SelectedFg, theme.SelectedBg)
	ColSelectedMatch = pair(theme.SelectedMatch, theme.SelectedBg)
	ColCurrent = pair(boldIf(theme.Current), theme.DarkBg)
	ColCurrentMatch = pair(boldIf(theme.CurrentMatch), theme.DarkBg)
	ColCurrentCursor = pair(boldIf(theme.Cursor), theme.DarkBg)
	ColCurrentCursorEmpty = pair(blank, theme.DarkBg)
	ColCurrentMarker = pair(boldIf(theme.Marker), theme.DarkBg)
	ColCurrentSelectedEmpty = pair(blank, theme.DarkBg)
	ColSpinner = pair(theme.Spinner, theme.InputBg)
	ColInfo = pair(theme.Info, theme.InputBg)
	ColHeader = pair(theme.Header, theme.HeaderBg)
	ColHeaderBg = pair(theme.Header, theme.HeaderBg)
	ColFooter = pair(theme.Footer, theme.FooterBg)
	ColFooterBg = pair(theme.Footer, theme.FooterBg)
	ColSeparator = pair(theme.Separator, theme.InputBg)
	ColScrollbar = pair(theme.Scrollbar, theme.ListBg)
	ColBorder = pair(theme.Border, theme.Bg)
	ColBorderLabel = pair(theme.BorderLabel, theme.Bg)
	ColPreviewLabel = pair(theme.PreviewLabel, theme.PreviewBg)
	ColPreview = pair(theme.PreviewFg, theme.PreviewBg)
	ColPreviewBorder = pair(theme.PreviewBorder, theme.PreviewBg)
	ColPreviewScrollbar = pair(theme.PreviewScrollbar, theme.PreviewBg)
	ColPreviewSpinner = pair(theme.Spinner, theme.PreviewBg)
	ColListBorder = pair(theme.ListBorder, theme.ListBg)
	ColListLabel = pair(theme.ListLabel, theme.ListBg)
	ColInputBorder = pair(theme.InputBorder, theme.InputBg)
	ColInputLabel = pair(theme.InputLabel, theme.InputBg)
	ColHeaderBorder = pair(theme.HeaderBorder, theme.HeaderBg)
	ColHeaderLabel = pair(theme.HeaderLabel, theme.HeaderBg)
	ColFooterBorder = pair(theme.FooterBorder, theme.FooterBg)
	ColFooterLabel = pair(theme.FooterLabel, theme.FooterBg)
	ColGapLine = pair(theme.GapLine, theme.ListBg)
	ColNth = pair(theme.Nth, theme.ListBg)
	ColAlt = pair(theme.ListFg, theme.AltBg)
	ColAltCursorEmpty = pair(blank, theme.AltGutter)
	ColAltSelectedEmpty = pair(blank, theme.AltBg)
	ColAltMarker = pair(boldIf(theme.Marker), theme.AltBg)
	ColAltMatch = pair(theme.Match, theme.AltBg)
}
